Study & Career Guide 2026

Live here. Learn here. Go far - Sem 2 Enrolments Now Open

Check it out! WITT's study programmes starting in July are now open to enrol! 

Toggle to see what courses are enrolling now. We have part-time study programmes as well as programmes that will get you a qualification before Christmas and a bunch of Fees free options! Browse our programmes now,  Enrol via the "Apply Now" button or reach out with any questions you have. We are here to assist! 

See July's programmes

Fees Free Professional Development Opportunity

Invest in your people at no course cost. Local businesses can nominate one staff member to study a selected New Zealand Diploma in Business (Level 5) course fees free, saving $929. With just one 3-hour class per week, it's a practical way to build leadership, business, and accounting skills while staying in the workforce.

Choose one of the course programmes.
